name: Barbeque
description:
The cooked meat of a defeated critter.

It has a delightful smoky aftertaste.

name: Berry Sludge
description:
A mashed up Bristle Berry sludge with an exceptionally long shelf life.

Its aggressive, overbearing sweetness can leave the tongue feeling temporarily numb.

name: Bog Jelly
description: A fruit with an outer film that contains chewy gelatinous cubes.

name: Bristle Berry
description: A sweet, mostly pleasant-tasting fruit covered in prickly barbs.

name: Calamari
description:
Uncooked meat from a very dead Glo Squid.

It's a little slippery.

name: Caviar
description:
Shelf-stable eggs from an aquatic critter.

It can be added to Food at a Mess Table to boost Morale.

Duplicants will automatically use Caviar while sitting at a Mess Table during mealtime.

name: Cooked Seafood
description:
A cooked piece of freshly caught aquatic critter.

Unsurprisingly, it tastes a bit fishy.

name: Curried Beans
description:
Chewy Nosh Beans simmered with chunks of Tonic Root.

It's so spicy!

name: Deep Fried Steak
description: A juicy slab of meat with a crunchy deep-fried upper layer.

name: Edamame
description:
Raw Nosh Beans sprinkled with Sodicane shavings.

Simple and satisfying.

name: Fish Fillet
description: An uncooked fillet from a very dead aquatic critter. Yum!

name: Fish Taco
description: Deep-fried fish cradled in a crunchy fin.

name: Fried Mushroom
description:
A pan-fried dish made with a fruiting Dusk Cap.

It has a thick, savory flavor with subtle earthy undertones.

name: Frost Bun
description:
A simple bun baked from Sleet Wheat Grain.

Each bite leaves a mild cooling sensation in one's mouth, even when the bun itself is warm.

name: Frost Burger
description:
Meat and Lettuce on a chilled Frost Bun.

It's the only burger best served cold.

name: Gamma Mush
description: A disturbingly delicious mixture of irradiated dirt and water.

name: Gristle Berry
description:
The grilled bud of a Bristle Berry.

Heat unlocked an exquisite taste in the fruit, though the burnt spines leave something to be desired.

name: Grubfruit
description: A plump, healthy fruit with a honey-like taste.

name: Grubfruit Preserve
description:
A long lasting Grubfruit jam preserved in Sucrose.

The thick, goopy jam retains the shape of the jar when poured out, but the sweet taste can't be matched.

name: Hexalent Fruit
description:
A seedless fruit with an unusual rubbery texture.

It cannot be replanted.

Hexalent fruit is much more calorie dense than Muckroot fruit.

name: Jawbo Fillet
description: An uncooked fillet from a very dead Jawbo. It has a silky texture.

name: Lettuce
description: Crunchy, slightly salty leaves from a Waterweed plant.

name: Liceloaf
description: Meal Lice compacted into a dense, immobile loaf.

name: Meal Lice
description: A flavorless grain that almost never wiggles on its own.

name: Meat
description: Uncooked meat from a very dead critter. Yum!

name: Megafrond Grain
description: An ancient grain that can be processed into Food.

name: Mimillet
description:
An inedible seed from a Mimika Bud.

It can be sown to cultivate more plants, or processed into Food.

Digging up Buried Objects may uncover a Mimillet Seed.

name: Mixed Berry Pie
description:
A pie made primarily of Grubfruit and Gristle Berries.

The mixture of berries creates a fragrant, colorful filling that packs a sweet punch.

name: Muckroot
description:
A seedless fruit with an upsettingly bland aftertaste.

It cannot be replanted.

Digging up Buried Objects may uncover a Muckroot.

name: Mush Bar
description:
An edible, putrefied mudslop.

Mush Bars are preferable to starvation, but only just barely.

name: Mush Fry
description:
Pan-fried, solidified mudslop.

The inside is almost completely uncooked, despite the crunch on the outside.

name: Mushroom
description: An edible, flavorless fungus that grew in the dark.

name: Mushroom Quiche
description:
Omelette, Fried Mushroom and Lettuce piled onto a yummy crust.

Somehow, it's both soggy and crispy.

name: Mushroom Wrap
description:
Flavorful Mushrooms wrapped in Lettuce.

It has an earthy flavor punctuated by a refreshing crunch.

name: Mussel Tongue
description:
Edible tongue of a Mussel Sprout.

It's bitter and chewy, but better than starvation.

name: Nigiri
description:
Tenderized Calamari and Liceloaf wrapped in Nori.

Expert preparation highlights the meat's delicate sweetness and soft, chewy texture.

name: Nori
description:
A bundle of slightly salty dried greenery from a Tower Kelp or Kelpole.

It's most commonly used as an ingredient in higher-tier dishes.

name: Nosh Bean
description: An inedible bean that can be processed into delicious foods.

name: Nosh Noms
description: A snackable handful of crunchy beans.

name: Nutrient Bar
description: A nourishing nutrient paste, sandwiched between thin wafer layers.

name: Omelette
description:
Fluffed and folded Egg innards.

It turns out you do, in fact, have to break a few eggs to make it.

name: Ovagro Fig
description:
The fruit from an Ovagro Vine.

It's fun to squeeze as many as possible into a single mouthful.

name: Pemmican
description:
Meat and Tallow pounded into a calorie-dense brick with an exceptionally long shelf life.

Survival never tasted so good.

name: Pepper Bread
description:
A loaf of bread, lightly spiced with Pincha Peppernut for a mild bite.

There's a simple joy to be had in pulling it apart in one's fingers.

name: Pickled Meal
description:
Meal Lice preserved in vinegar.

It's a rarely acquired taste.

name: Pikeapple
description: An edible fruit encased in a thorny husk.

name: Pikeapple Skewer
description:
Grilling a Pikeapple softens its spikes, making it slighly less awkward to eat.

It does not diminish the smell.

name: Pincha Peppernut
description:
The flavorful nut of a Pincha Pepperplant.

The bitter outer rind hides a rich, peppery core that is useful in cooking.

name: Plant Meat
description: Planty plant meat from a plant. How nice!

name: Plume Squash
description: An edible tuber with an earthy, elegant flavor.

name: Raw Egg
description:
A raw Egg that has been cracked open for use in Food preparation.

It will never hatch.

name: Raw Shellfish
description: An uncooked chunk of very dead Sanishell. Yum!

name: Roast Grubfruit Nut
description:
Slow roasted Spindly Grubfruit.

It has a smoky aroma and tastes of coziness.

name: Salty Sticks
description:
An extremely salty snack harvested from a Sodicane.

Visiting a Water Cooler will counteract the Thirst caused by eating Salty Sticks.

name: Shellfish Tempura
description: A crispy deep-fried critter claw.

name: Sherberry
description:
A cold seedless fruit that triggers mild brain freeze.

It cannot be replanted.

name: Sleet Wheat Grain
description: An edible grain that leaves a cool taste on the tongue.

name: Smoked Fish
description:
A buttery smoked fish fillet.

It flakes nicely when pulled apart with a fork.

name: Snac Fruit
description:
A seedless fruit that loses its flavor long before it is fully chewed.

It cannot be replanted.

Digging up Buried Objects may uncover a Snac Fruit.

name: Soufflé Pancakes
description:
Sweet discs made from Raw Egg and Sleet Wheat Grain.

They're so thick!

name: Spicy Tofu
description:
Tofu marinated in a flavorful Pincha Peppernut sauce.

It packs a delightful punch.

name: Spindly Grubfruit
description:
A Grubfruit that failed to develop properly.

It is nonetheless edible, and vaguely tasty.

name: Squash Fries
description:
Irresistibly crunchy.

Best eaten hot.

name: Stuffed Berry
description: A baked Bristle Berry stuffed with delectable spices and vibrantly flavored.

name: Surf'n'Turf
description:
A bit of Meat from the land and Cooked Seafood from the sea.

It's hearty and satisfying.

name: Sushi Roll
description:
Raw Fish Fillet paired with Liceloaf and wrapped in Nori.

The salty, crispy wrap balances perfectly with the juicy proteins inside.

name: Swamp Chard Heart
description:
A seedless plant with a squishy, juicy center and an awful smell.

It cannot be replanted.

name: Swampy Delights
description:
Dried gelatinous cubes from a Bog Jelly.

Each cube has a wonderfully chewy texture and is lightly coated in a delicate powder.

name: Sweatcorn
description:
The sugary vegetable produced by Sweatcorn Stalks.

It tastes a lot better deep-fried.

name: Tender Brisket
description: A cooked stack of tough meat that's been marinated and slow-smoked to tender perfection.

name: Toasted Mimillet
description:
A lightly toasted Mimillet.

It makes the tummy feel a bit fluttery.

name: Tofu
description:
A bland curd made from Nosh Beans.

It has an unusual but pleasant consistency.

name: Tough Meat
description:
Uncooked meat from a very dead critter.

It's inedible until cooked in the Smoker.

name: Uni
description:
The edible flesh of a Pinpoki.

A rare delicacy whose safe preparation involves destroying the valuable outer spikes.

name: Veggie Poppers
description: Crisp vegetables stuffed with herbs and smoked for hours.
